firms.note: NOAA-21 begins 2024-01-17 because JPSS-2 data became available then; that is not a collection gap. Its files are fire_nrt_*, every other file is fire_archive_*.
firms.caveat: Per the NASA README, standard-quality data is not yet available for NOAA-20 and NOAA-21, so J1V/J2V files are NRT while MODIS and S-NPP archive files are standard. The two differ in confidence semantics and FRP: baseline and train on standard, use NOAA-20/21 for temporal coverage.
